title: PTY / sandbox dependency boundary
description: intent/isolation.md invariant: the PTY layer must not know about Bubblewrap. The PTY runner source MUST NOT reference the Bubblewrap backend or bwrap mechanics; it accepts only a prepared process. Accepting only a prepared process is a constraint on the runner's arguments as much as on its vocabulary: a launch input arriving beside the prepared process rather than inside it leaves the runner reading two sources, and a second source is where backend knowledge re-enters. The working directory is that input, so the runner reads it from the prepared process and takes no separate path argument. Discharged by the pty-sandbox-boundary checker in verification support, which scans the PTY runner source. Attested by the @contract scenario in features/pty-sandbox-boundary.feature.
rationale: New sandbox backends must never change the PTY architecture. The PTY runner takes a PreparedProcess and launches it verbatim. A field the prepared process declares and the runner never reads is the same divergence as a field it does not declare at all: the shape validates, the capability is carried elsewhere, and every attestation stays green.
